nom: Clarins Total Cleansing Oil & Makeup Remover

avis.texte: Works to cleanse but I can't get past the smell. Fragrance is hit or miss with me and Clarins.
This cleansing oil leaves my skin feeling soft, clean, and comfortable. The light texture and gentle formula make it a luxurious, reliable staple in my nightly routine.

avis.titre: Great features, but unfortunately not for me.
avis.texte: Texture and smell is so nice, removes makeup very easily. I always follow up any oil cleansers with face wash, to make sure I wash it off. It was only one new item in my routine that broke me. Unfortunately I am sensitive to some ingredients.

avis.titre: Best cleansing oil on the market
avis.texte: Have been using this cleansing oil religiously for years! Once you dab off the excess after massaging it on your face, you apply the cleansing lotions and massage that. After a few seconds the mixture of the two melts, and then removal with a warm damp cloth is easy. Not any other oil does this emulsifying!
I am on my second refill. This oil removes makeup and daily impurities so well. The smell is good but not as great as other products. I would still recommend due to its qualities

This is one of my all time favorite Clarins products and now I have the option to have it in a refillable size- win, win. The cleanser is a must have part of my daily routine and provides a deep clean without dehydrating my skin. The consistency is perfect (I was initially concerned with an oil based product) and I love the oil. The oil is easy to refill- no mess.
It's a reliable everyday cleansing oil that works well for normal use.

I will only use this to total cleansing oil to take off my makeup. Wearing my makeup all day can leave my face feeling dry however using this product to remove my makeup immediately rehydrates my skin and allows for easier removal so its more gentle on my face. Feels amazing and works like a dream removing every bit of makeup even on heavy makeup days.
I have used this for years and will continue to do so! Dissolves even water proof makeup and leaves your skin so soft and hydrated!

avis.titre: One step to clean and moisturized
avis.texte: I buy this product on repeat. It's a one-step cleanser. You slather it on, remove your makeup, then add water to create a milky consistency and rinse off. It smells amazing and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean.
I love this makeup remover. I love the oil feel when you first rub it all over your face. I get in there rubbing my mascara off and also my false lashes glue. I enjoy this makeup remover.
I tried a sample of this, and while it's really nice, it's too thin for my liking. I need to add more than I usually do to get all of my makeup and sunscreen off at the end of the day.

I'm not going to lie, I have been gatekeeping this one for a while… but after about 5 bottles of this stuff, I must share that it is the best oil cleanser on the market. It is perfectly gentle, does not trigger acne/pimples at all- if anything, it keeps my skin more clear. Massaging your face with this daily will also help wit appearance of blackheads. It feels luxurious, scent is mild/barely there, and my skin is bright and hydrated after use. It gets makeup off like a charm and is the only facial cleanser I use. I need a bottle for my shower and my bathroom counter. It's pricey but lives up to its price tag when comparing it to cheaper oil cleansers.
This does a great job as a first cleanse it's delicate but effective

avis.titre: Actually removes my makeup and cleanses
avis.texte: I got this as a sample with another purchase and fell in love. It easily removes my waterproof makeup without stripping my face of oils. It's a beautiful smell and texture.
Excellent at removing makeup! Dissolves everything very well. Follow with foaming cleanser for full removal.
I like this. I dont always wear long-wear makeup but when I do this does the job of removing it all in one pass.

avis.titre: Lovely way to end the day
avis.texte: I use this every night and massage it into my skin for quite some time, watching a programme on my desktop. You feel it work into your skin, gathering up the day's makeup while gently exfoliating. I then use a Clarins face cleanser. I use cotton wool to remove both and finish with a toner. The cleansing oil is just so meditative and my skin is soft and clean and ready for serum and moisturiser. Love it
This product has an amazing texture! It leaves the skin clean and hydrated! I love it!
I guess sending samples works! I got a sample of this when I got the double serum and fell in love. It's so smooth and works great.
Best makeup remover! Better than any other big brands out there.

This is an amazing pre cleanser! It easily gets off all your makeup. I recently tried a different oil cleanser because it was a tad bit cheaper and its not even close to this one. I will be purchasing this one from now on.
really nice cleanser —a Little goes long — cleans the skin fast without drying it out —luxurious
Don't like this cleansing oil. Weird consistency and doesn't lather much. I'll stick with the other cleansers.

Great oil cleanser! This is what I use at the end of the day to remove my long wear foundation and water resistant sunscreen and it does the job. My skin doesn't feel tight or dry afterwards and it even gets off stubborn eye makeup. Will definitely purchase again.
This is the best pre cleanser I've used, and I have tried many. I'm on my 3rd bottle and it lasts quite long. I use it at night and sometimes in the morning also.
This cleanser works great but I cant get past the smell and I'll use the rest but won't buy again.
So glad I bought this. Takes off the waterproof makeup...including mascara and lipstick !! Outstanding....moisturizes your face and washes clean. Clarins is a wonderful product

I really wanted to consider this as I look for a cleansing oil to commit to... and have to say I'm rather shocked that Clarins has any product, particularly when cleansing and can be inhaled, this ingredient : PEG-20 GLYCERYL TRIISOSTEARATE; there really is no reason to have any of the chemical ingredients in a cleansing OIL

I think this cleanser works great and it does remove eye makeup but it absolutely smells horrible - almost rancid - which is a huge disappointment being used to Clarins products usually smelling wonderful. Won't buy again :(

Smells great, works decently. I have used other cleansing oils that I like better, but overall I am enjoying it. Would I buy this one again....maybe not mainly because I do not think it takes off make up as well as other cleansing oils.
It cleanses wonderfully and the skin becomes very smooth, but it smells absolutely terrible. Maybe the product is spoiled? Usually, Clarins' scents are very exquisite

avis.titre: Another home run face cleanser from Clarins
avis.texte: The smell and the efficacy of this product are truly beyond what I expected. thank you again Clarins for a great smelling and effecgtive product. Just with the refill size was bigger to reduce plastic waste..
The best for removing makeup. Easy to apply. I tried different products for removing my makeup and this is the best .

avis.titre: Can't get past the awful scent of this product..
avis.texte: I bought this a month or so ago in an attempt to find a product like Tatcha's Camilla oil. I cannot use it b/o the scent. It just makes me gag.
Lovely cleanser, protects skin barrier but also cleans well. Smells great - light and clean.

I really do enjoy this oil. The scent is nice, and the oil does not feel too heavy or sticky on my skin. Alongside makeup removal, I noticed it helps with sebum control. A very useful skincare product and great for your skin!

I've been using Clarins Cleansing Milk for years but after watching a YouTube video from Clarins UK, I decided to try the cleansing oil. It's is Amazing! I'm 57 with dry, dehydrated, sensitive skin. My skin feels clean but soft and comfortable after I've washed my face. The smell is spa like and I look forward to washing my face each night. It also removes my eye makeup. I follow up with the hydrating toner ( yellow), double serum and super restorative.
I don't like this smell I don't think I will buy this anymore
Removes all makeup and sunscreen easily! Skin feels soft and clean afterwards and my sensitive skin isnt irritated at all.
I really love this cleanser, it removes all my make up in one go, and a little goes a long way! It is not drying at all. I wish it wasn't this expensive, but I will defo repurchase it.
This is fabulous. The product removes the impurities in the skin. It leaves my face feeling clean and hydrated.

I've tried mixing my own DIY oil blends for removing makeup as it would save a lot of money in the long run, but I end up with a greasy face or a mess that refuses to rinse off. Clarins' is honestly little more than glorified Sunflower Oil (fancy I know!) but it does the trick! The only issue with my bottle is it's slightly rancid (probably not stored in the right conditions instore), so I can't comment on the fragrance as it's half-gone. But the product still works well. I don't use it for removing eye makeup, only to remove foundation/concealer etc. The pump dispenses easily, and with a simple twist to the left, it seals shut for travel, the oil itself glides on easily and has a nice silky texture. It dissolves makeup well and it washes off in seconds, without leaving my already-oily skin, any more oily. I then follow with a normal gel cleanser. I've used a couple of oil cleansers in the past and this one is my favorite. I just wish it cost a bit less...I can't see it lasting for much more than a month, based on how much I've already gone through in the last few days. -> My 'Ulta Beauty Top 7 must-have list' (My 7 favorite beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Ulta) < - < 1. Hair Loss Treatment: Divine Herbal Hair Oil < 2. Eye Cream: Clinique All about eyes < 3. Lip Gloss: Clarins Lip Comfort Oil < 4. Makeup Remover: Lancome Bi Facil < 5. Pigmentation + Anti-Aging Serum: Divine Herbal Facial Treatment Serum < 6. Eyeliner: Ulta Beauty Gel Eyeliner P

This cleansing oil is fabulous, it's like a little massage for your face, completely dissolves any makeup including stubborn mascara and leaves skin smooth and plump. I buy on repeat, and was delighted to see Clarins offer a large refill, great to have on hand and to reuse the original bottle. This oil does not clog pores or make skin oily or greasy.

I recently purchased this because I wanted to give an oil cleanser a try instead of my usual beloved sensibio micellar water and I'm glad I did! This will be something I buy again and again! I'm usually very nervous to switch up my routine because I have acne prone combo skin that is sensitive and gets red and angry over anything but this has not irritated my skin. I actually never write reviews but I'm such a fan I had to.

I really like this cleansing oil. It leaves my face feeling very clean, but not dry. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because I'm not sure about the smell. It is just when you apply it. Not lasting, after your rinse your face. I am a little crazy when it comes to how things smell though. I would recommend the product. I've been looking for a replacement for the Blue Aloe cream cleanser that was discontinued. I tried the velvet cream cleanser, but I don't care for the fragrance (and it does linger on after use).
I have always used this cleanser, I find it dissolves any makeup and makes my skin feel supple.

Okay this is like $40, BUT it lasted me months. Maybe 4? You could get 5 if you do one pump i think. I wear alot of makeup and i always go in with a remover then my makeup eraser to get residue off. This gets eye makeup off with ease and i never was rubbing my eyes with the eraser like some other products. I dont feel the greasy feeling after and i have acne skin, this didn't seem to clog pores. I only needed 1 pump but did two to reeealy spread it around. It's some money but for how long it lasted i am going to repurchase and feel confident that i dont need to work hard to get my makeup off at the end of the day. :)!
so excited to use! been looking for ways to be more eco friendly and stoked you guys offer this product I love in bulk
Very light and effective as a precleanser for me….first time using. I like it very much and would buy again
I purchase this after using the cleansing oil sample, I like its scent.

This review is long overdue. Dont know why this is so under the radar but maybe thats a good thing so its not sold out.. I wear a full face of waterproof makeup and at the end of the day I enjoy reaching for this. 2 pumps into my hand, warm it up by rubbing my hands together than massaging over my face. Everything, and I mean everything, just melts effortlessly.. then I wet my hands with water and massage over face again for the foam up. Rinse. Wash wit my regular cleanser after. I enjoy the smell, the massage, the thorough removal, the feel, and the softness after. Have used this for 2yrs and can't imagine a day without this. So happy that it comes in a refill bag.
